summary: BifrOSt has manual value observation: an Observable<T> that notifies subscribers only when the value changes, with Combine-style sink, map and remove_duplicates. It has none of Observation's automatic dependency tracking, the @Observable macro, or the async Observations sequence.

features.note: No per-type macro that synthesizes change notification for every stored property. Observable<T> wraps one whole value, not a model object's properties.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/observable.rs (Observable::set, subscribe, sink); springboard/ui/src/observe.rs (Observable<T>::set, subscribe(old, new))
features.note: Notifies only when the value differs (PartialEq). Two copies exist: the SDK one (Rc, Combine-style, sink delivers current value) and the UI-model one (old and new values passed to subscribers). A set from inside a subscriber of the same observable updates the value but notifies no one (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1435).
Subscribers must be attached explicitly to each Observable. Nothing records which values a closure read. docs/bifrost-ui.md:1435 lists this gap.
No async sequence of transactional changes. Subscribers are synchronous callbacks on the single UI thread (the SDK Observable is single-threaded, Rc).
Subscription cancels on drop (AnyCancellable). No event or options types for tracking.
Macro-only behaviour of the Swift language; with no macro in BifrOSt there is nothing to mark.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs (observe_thermal_state, observe_low_power_mode); docs/bifrost-ui.md:1214 (NotificationCenter add_observer, post); docs/bifrost-ui.md:1542 (workspace observe)
features.note: Observer-style subscriptions exist for system events (NotificationCenter, workspace, thermal state, Low Power Mode). They are not Observation's property-level tracking.

gaps: No automatic dependency capture (withObservationTracking) and no @Observable macro equivalent: each Observable must be wired by hand.
No async Observations sequence or withContinuousObservation.
A set from inside a subscriber of the same Observable notifies no one (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1435).
SwiftUI-style integration (view invalidation from observed model state) not verified in code; no binding found in this pass.
